logParser.faqDesc: Plain language explanations of common MOD terminology
logParser.faqSMAPIAnswer: SMAPI is the mod loader for Stardew Valley. Almost all mods require it to run. Think of it as the 'launcher' for mods.
logParser.faqPrefixAnswer: A dependency is another mod that a mod needs to work. For example, if Mod A needs Mod B to function, then B is a dependency of A. Missing dependencies will cause mods to fail loading.
logParser.faqContentPackAnswer: A content pack is a special type of mod that doesn't run on its own, but adds content to another mod. For example, adding new NPCs or maps to a large expansion mod.
logParser.faqManifestAnswer: manifest.json is the 'ID card' for each mod. It contains the mod's name, version, author, dependencies, and more. Without this file, SMAPI cannot recognize the mod.
logParser.faqConflictAnswer: A mod conflict occurs when two or more mods modify the same part of the game. For example, if two mods both want to change the same NPC's dialogue, it may cause crashes or display issues.
logParser.faqUpdateKeyAnswer: An UpdateKey is a marker used by mod authors to identify where updates come from, usually containing the Nexus Mods mod ID. SVL can use it to automatically check if a mod has a new version.

faq.q1Title: Why do I need an API Key?
faq.q1Answer: The API Key is an interface token provided by Nexus Mods to verify your identity and permissions. It is needed for the API-based mod search feature. Browsing and downloading in the Nexus Browser does not require an API Key.
faq.q2Title: Will mods be installed automatically after downloading?
faq.q2Answer: Yes! When you click the download button in the Nexus Browser, SVL automatically identifies the download page, clicks Manual Download and Slow Download, then extracts and installs to your Mods folder - no manual action needed.
faq.q3Title: How does the Nexus Browser auto-download work?
faq.q3Answer: After logging in, find a mod's Files page and click download. SVL automatically handles the Manual → Slow Download flow, then installs to your Mods folder. You only need to log in and click download - SVL takes care of the rest.
